A recorded owner/status that no longer matches the derivation is a stale-record failure.

notes: A within-axis relative claim is unaffected: both worlds step exactly 2x per axis (the PDK moscap model's C ~ c_length*c_width form makes the 2x/Min C ratio exactly 2.000 at fixed bias), so relative comparisons recorded per region hold.

An absolute claim does not: yield at a given VPP for a given C, or I_sneak_max at N=32, taken from one world does not describe the other until these entries are resolved (design/README.md PROVISIONAL open item 1(a)).
